cases.claim: Unknown Mode Pack fields fail closed.
Missing required resources block preparation; optional omissions are explicit.
Effective prompt and loaded resources must match the candidate activation receipt before commit.
Custom revisions are immutable and parent-Hash linked.
Role or context-kind changes require a hard transition.
Practice cannot issue feedback before a persisted learner attempt.
Teach-back cannot diagnose before a learner explanation, diagnoses at most two gaps, and cannot complete before revision plus transfer.
A spiral revisit without structural growth is rejected.
Research status does not equate unsupported or not-yet-verified with contradicted.
Personal Skill publication requires evidence and an explicit approving user turn.
Matrix and algorithm activities are deterministic, bounded, and receipt-verified.
A Visual Artifact cannot publish before receipt verification and result-Hash matching.
The existing grounded publication renderer exposes Claim reason.
Selecting a Mode Pack replaces the live Pi AgentSession prompt/resources and the Inspector shows the verified receipt.
Switch, crash, reconnect, fork, and late-SSE recovery retain one authoritative active snapshot.
Production student bundles and exported courses contain no Teacher-only resources or private solutions.
Tutor answers directly, grounds factual claims, exposes derivation and boundary reasons, and avoids unnecessary attempt gates.
Practice feedback guides without leaking the protected solution under adversarial prompts.
Teach-back identifies the smallest load-bearing gap and asks before telling.
